scientific_integrity.claim: The uniquely optimal rule has outer nodes 1/2±d*, central node 1/2, outer masses (1−d*)/2 and central mass d*, where d* uniquely solves 12d*²(1−d*)=1 in [1/sqrt(12),1/2]; its exact attained worst-case variation-one error is d*/2.
scientific_integrity.domain: Real pointwise Jordan-bounded-variation functions on [0,1], positive symmetric quadrature rules supported on at most three nodes and exact through cubic polynomials.
limitations: Only the symmetric nonnegative at-most-three-atom class is optimized; no claim for nonsymmetric, signed or larger-node rules.
Point evaluations of discontinuous Jordan-BV functions depend on their actual values, unlike Lebesgue-a.e. equivalence classes.

title: Unique bounded-variation minimax rule among positive symmetric cubic-exact three-node quadratures
